def _add_header_create_object(headers, client=None):
    """ Create a new bucket, add an object w/header customizations
    """
    bucket_name = get_new_bucket()
    if client == None:
        client = get_client()
    key_name = 'foo'

    # pass in custom headers before PutObject call
    add_headers = (lambda **kwargs: kwargs['params']['headers'].update(headers))
    client.meta.events.register('before-call.s3.PutObject', add_headers)
    client.put_object(Bucket=bucket_name, Key=key_name)

    return bucket_name, key_name

def _remove_header_create_object(remove, client=None):
    """ Create a new bucket, add an object without a header
    """
    bucket_name = get_new_bucket()
    if client == None:
        client = get_client()
    key_name = 'foo'

    # remove custom headers before PutObject call
    def remove_header(**kwargs):
        if (remove in kwargs['params']['headers']):
            del kwargs['params']['headers'][remove]

    client.meta.events.register('before-call.s3.PutObject', remove_header)
    client.put_object(Bucket=bucket_name, Key=key_name)

    return bucket_name, key_name

signing_evidence.source_header_event: before-call.s3.PutObject/CreateBucket before actual SDK signing; no post-sign mutation substitution
signing_evidence.java_actual_sdk: aws-sdk-java-v2 auth2.20.162 exposes AwsS3V4Signer, Aws4Signer, Aws4UnsignedPayloadSigner; existing S3 target uses official V4 default, no implemented ordinary-request V2 producer
signing_evidence.cpp_actual_sdk: AWSAuthV4Signer/NullSigner/BearerSigner/EventStreamV4Signer public official headers; S3ClientConfiguration exposes PayloadSigningPolicy on V4; existing S3 identities construct V4 S3Client
signing_evidence.current_bridge_gap: ordinary put/create RPC has no strict signature_version selection; sending an ignored extra field could silently use V4 and is forbidden
signing_evidence.presign_comparison: Existing four presigned V2 source vectors have complete generic presign consumer logic and explicit missing presign_v2 gate; that capability does not implement ordinary authenticated V2 requests

requirements_before_execution: actual official SDK V2 ordinary signer producer
strict signature-version RPC selection and signing_v2 capability only when actual producer exists
physical wire proof Authorization AWS access:signature for valid V2 source requests; invalid literal headers stay original
genuine native status/error metadata; no canned service error synthesis
owned isolated bucket cleanup using unmodified main identity and only actual created ownership
expected_not_claims: No aligned reviews or executable registry entries are added
No hand-written HMAC signer or V4 substitution
Zero HTTP preflight tests alone cannot establish V2 support
